findings.detail: The source SOI total rows report nonzero percent-of-net-assets totals, but the extracted A07 aggregate is 0.0%.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate check. The queue metric reports pct_sum=0.0%, but the raw filing's Schedule of Investments total row reports Total Investments fair value of 1,928,018.3 and 153.02% of net assets; a related total row also reports 73.28%. The source therefore contains nonzero percent-of-net-assets data, so a zero observed aggregate is an extraction/column capture gap rather than a faithful source value.
